title: console: on an approval-locked record whose default page has a body table, the "Locked for approval" chip draws twice (above the table and above the next section)
body:
repo:hotcrm#2 · os-mickey · session_01ASNY8XiE8ZJYbrmzFDtS9g

**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible defect, reproduced once in the console.

**Business reason.** A deal waiting for approval shows a "Locked for approval" chip, so a rep knows why the fields are read-only. When the record's line items are a body table (`relatedList: 'primary'`, record page v4), the chip draws twice on one page. The page reads as if two separate locks applied. Every object with a body table and an approval process shows this. hotcrm's opportunity does since objectstack-ai/hotcrm PR #2671.

**Reach (measured once).** hotcrm PR #2671 head `98f790dd`, `@objectstack/*` 18.6.0, `objectstack dev`. A pending-approval `crm_opportunity` was opened as `na.rep` and as `sales.manager` at 1440 px. "Locked for approval" draws above the line-item body table and again above the next details section. Control: the retired authored page (no body table) drew it once. The evidence is the before/after screenshots of the same deal, in the hotcrm seat report on #2382.

Expected: one lock chip per record page, however many body sections the synthesized page splits the details into.

**Seam.** `renderer:plugin-detail` `buildDefaultPageSchema`: the details body is split around a body table, and each part draws the approval-lock chip.

**Reader.** objectstack triage grades it and routes it to the record-page lane. Not a claim; it awaits triage.

**Dedupe** (`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue`, open and closed): `Locked for approval chip twice` → 51 hits, all QA runs or unrelated; `approval lock badge duplicated body table` → 18, none on point.
